js: (() => { const G = window.G; if (G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); const tc = document.getElementById('tc'); return JSON.stringify({ touch: !!window.__touch, grob: matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches, fein: matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches, tc: tc && tc.style.display, w: innerWidth, h: innerHeight, q: G.opts.quality }); })()
(() => { const G = window.G; if (!G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); return String(!!G.player.car); })()

(() => { const G = window.G; if (G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Escape', key: 'Escape' })); return document.getElementById('menu').style.display; })()
(() => { const G = window.G; G.X.closeMenu(); G.PHONE.open(); return String(G.PHONE.isOpen); })()
(() => { window.G.PHONE.close(); return JSON.stringify({ w: innerWidth, h: innerHeight, rot: document.getElementById('tcrot').style.display }); })()
